name: LogoLoop-TS-TW
title: Logo Marquee Loop
description: A single row of white brand marks scrolls steadily past under a small "Trusted by teams at" label, dissolving at both edges and pausing for the pointer.
use: A landing page needs to show a set of customer or partner logos in a narrow band.
avoid: It never stops unless hovered, and the built-in edge fade needs a matching background colour.
a11y: Duplicate logo copies are aria-hidden and the strip has a region label; reduced-motion stops the scroll entirely. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A strip of white monochrome brand logos, all the same height, evenly spaced on black, with a small centred label above. Both ends fade out into the background.
behaves: The row slides left in a continuous loop that wraps around itself without a jump. Hovering slows it to a stop and each logo grows slightly under the pointer.
customise: Pass a logos array of icon nodes or image sources with optional links. Speed, direction, width, logo height, gap, hover behaviour, fades, scale and aria label are props.
weight: light: A single requestAnimationFrame loop transforms one track; no per-logo animation.
